title: Route anth.us production through Amplify
description: The Amplify main branch build succeeds, but anth.us and www.anth.us still alias the legacy CloudFront distribution E2D59YWXV0QSUJ backed by anthus-site S3. Attach the custom domain to Amplify main, migrate DNS safely, and verify the Jev article update on canonical production.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: production DNS still pointed at legacy CloudFront distribution E2D59YWXV0QSUJ, and Amplify custom-domain setup initially failed because that distribution still owned anth.us and www.anth.us. Released both aliases; attached anth.us/www to Amplify main; updated Route 53 apex A alias and www CNAME to Amplify target d335lqlgq6ort3.cloudfront.net. Verified both hostnames return HTTP 200 and the updated Jev caption/Jersey 25 styling. Amplify currently reports AWAITING_APP_CNAME for the apex (www verified), even though the Route 53 alias resolves and production requests return the new page; keeping issue in progress to confirm AWS status settles.
